note: What a client sends to cast something from a slot, at a point or at a unit.

bits.name: fromSummonerSlots
bits.note: Set where the slot counts among the summoner slots rather than the unit's own.

bits.name: fromHud
bits.note: Set where the cast came from clicking the panel rather than the world.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Purpose undetermined. A client leaves these as it found them, so they carry values it never wrote for this message.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Which slot is being cast from. Slots for a unit's own spells and for items both appear here.

fields.name: x
fields.note: A point on the ground the cast is described by, along one axis, in world units.

fields.name: z
fields.note: The same point, along the other axis.

fields.name: endX
fields.note: A second point, along one axis. Every cast observed carried the same point twice, so nothing shows which of the two is where the cast begins and which is where it is aimed.

fields.name: endZ
fields.note: The second point, along the other axis.

fields.name: target
fields.note: The network object aimed at, or zero where the cast is aimed at ground.
